intro: Numbers for the association and for the public desks residents use. For danger, fire, or a medical emergency, use the emergency page first.

groups.title: Association
groups.note: Add the secretary’s phone and any lane representative in this list.

items.name: Association desk
items.detail: Day-to-day questions, notices, and membership papers.
items.note: The phone number is published from the site settings once the committee adds it.

items.name: Secretary
items.note: Add the name and number on the committee page.

groups.title: Electricity and water
groups.note: Statewide helplines published by the Kerala State Disaster Management Authority. They are not association numbers.

groups.title: Civic desks to add
groups.note: Leave these blank until someone confirms the current number. A wrong ward or station number is worse than a blank one.

items.name: Ward office / councillor
items.note: Add the ward name and the current number.

items.name: Local police station
items.detail: For a non-emergency report after you have called 112 if there is danger.
items.note: Add the station that covers Dr. CRP Nagar.

items.name: Nearest hospital
items.note: Add the name and the reception number.
